meta.source: Sergio Beleño Brand Manual v1.0 (August 2026), section 15 Token Reference, and serbeld.space

color.note: One accent, three surfaces, three text weights. Dark only: the identity, the portrait and the wordmark are specified for dark grounds. Application ratio ≈ 70% color-bg, 20% surface layers, 8% text, 2% accent.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Signal Blue, the single accent. Primary buttons, links, active nav, section index, skill-bar fill, focus outline. As text: 7.96:1 on color-bg, 7.36:1 on color-surface, 6.77:1 on color-surface-2. Reserve for what the visitor can act on or must notice.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for every accent surface (primary button, submit). color-text-on-accent on it reaches 10.11:1.

tokens.name: color-accent-dark
tokens.usage: Alternate accent for rules, dividers, large numerals and decorative fills. Exactly 4.50:1 on color-bg and 4.16:1 on color-surface, so never body copy and never text below 18px; on color-surface only at 24px and up.

tokens.name: color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and soft-button backgrounds (Tag, ServiceCard action, active Tab). Flattens to #1a222b on color-bg, #212a36 on color-surface. color-accent text on it: 6.02:1 or better.

tokens.name: color-accent-shadow
tokens.usage: Border of the current TimelineCard and of Tags. Decorative: the Current badge carries the meaning in words. Flattens to #304560 on color-bg.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page background, the base layer (~70% of any screen). Also the ink of the wordmark on a Signal Blue field. Mobile theme-color must match it.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav panels, the portrait backing (~20% with surface-2).

tokens.name: color-surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, skill-bar tracks, wells inside a card, skeleton base.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline between surfaces: card shells, nav bottom, footer top, section-heading rule. Decorative only (1.2:1 on color-bg).

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders, input borders, outline button, skeleton highlight. Source value kept: 1.56:1 on color-bg is below the 3:1 non-text guideline, so a field is identified by its visible label, and focus turns the border color-accent.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary copy. 15.53:1 on color-bg, 14.37:1 on color-surface, 13.21:1 on color-surface-2 (AAA).

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, nav links, meta. 7.65:1 on color-bg, 7.08:1 on color-surface, 6.51:1 on color-surface-2 (AAA on bg and surface).

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, captions, footer, percentages, empty states. 6.15:1 on color-bg, 5.69:1 on color-surface, 5.23:1 on color-surface-2 (AA).

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a color-accent or color-accent-hover fill (primary button, submit, skip link): 7.96:1 and 10.11:1.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Confirmation only, always with a word (Sent, DO). 11.00:1 on color-bg, 10.18:1 on color-surface.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Validation errors only, always with a message (DO NOT, field errors). 6.42:1 on color-bg, 5.94:1 on color-surface. Differs from color-success by hue more than lightness (1.71:1), so never rely on the colour alone.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Offline banner and system-level warnings, as a fill or a rule. Source value kept: as text it is 3.82:1 on color-bg and 3.53:1 on color-surface (fails body text), and color-text on a warning fill is 4.07:1 (large or bold 19px+ only). Set warning copy in color-text beside a warning rule.

groups.name: Structure
groups.note: Poppins: headings, navigation, buttons, labels. The geometric, engineered voice. Poppins never sets a paragraph.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: The name in the hero, the only h1, in color-text.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Section titles (h2) inside SectionHeading, in color-text.

styles.name: hero-role
styles.usage: The animated role line under the hero name, in color-text-muted; reserves 28px min-height.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Timeline, blog and contact card titles (h3), in color-text.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the nav, its working context. Never below 14px.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Nav links and tab labels in color-text-muted; color-accent on hover and when active.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Button and submit labels, verb first.

styles.name: section-index
styles.usage: Two-digit section index with a leading zero, in color-accent.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase, color-accent, always directly above the heading it introduces.

styles.name: form-label
styles.usage: Field labels in color-text-muted, 8px above the field.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates and meta in color-text-faint; the Current badge.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Lekton: body copy, paragraphs, meta information. The technical monospaced face that signals the engineering context. Lekton never sets a heading or a button.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I work across the full stack to deliver solutions from system architecture down to pixel-level detail.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: I build fast, reliable e-commerce experiences with React, Node.js, and VTEX.
styles.usage: The hero tagline in color-text-muted, capped at 520px.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card meta, descriptions, excerpts, empty states (in color-text-faint).

styles.name: input-text
styles.usage: Text typed into inputs and textareas, in color-text.

styles.name: footer-text
styles.usage: Footer copyright and build credit, in color-text-faint.

spacing.note: Eight steps on a 4px base. No value outside the scale belongs in a stylesheet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, tight label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, label above field, skill-bar height.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Section-heading gaps, button pairs, social icon gap, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Timeline logo gap, container padding at 720px and below, footer social gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, container padding on desktop, skill-grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section heading to content, service-card padding, footer padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding at 720px and below.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop; equals the nav height.

radius.note: Three radii, each with one job.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, focus outlines, skip link, timeline logos.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The hero portrait only; used nowhere else.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Skill-bar track and fill, Tags, social icons (with 50%). The manual writes it as a literal 999px; named here so it has one source.

shadow.note: Two elevations. Cards rest on hairlines, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The hero portrait.

tokens.name: container-width
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, centred, with space-5 gutters (space-4 at 720px and below).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav height and the scroll-margin offset for section anchors.
